Voluminous, curly golden blonde hair styled in ringlets with a small crown perched on top. Bright, haughty sapphire blue eyes with a confident expression. Apparent age is mid-teens with a refined, royal demeanor. Petite and slender build. A lavish, royal white and gold dress with a large blue bow and white gloves. Signature accessories include a small scepter and ornate white stockings.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
